alignment.dtConvention: dtUs = eventTimeUs - referenceTimeUs, nonnegative in this W632 observation.
alignment.coordinates: Original sensor coordinates: pixel centers, top-left origin, x right, y down. No rotation or recentering.
alignment.warpConvention: warped = float32(raw + (t_ref - t) * velocity); relative timestamps converted from microseconds to seconds.
alignment.interpolation: raw + amount * (warped - raw), amount in [0,1]; intermediate values illustrate recorded motion compensation.
alignment.sampling: 8000 evenly spaced retained-event indices, including first and last; signs and chronological pairing preserved.
alignment.imageSampling: Fallback PNGs include all 61648 recorded events, nearest-pixel display. The web scatter is a deterministic 8000-event subset.
alignment.outsideSensor: Off-sensor warped coordinates remain in data and bounds; raster fallback clips to fixed native sensor bounds.

provenance.images: Original full-window IWE/pIWE arrays, native346x260; grayscale zero-to-IWE-max, symmetric signed pIWE with full-field max(abs). No minimum subtraction, geometric edits, or fabricated density.
provenance.alignment: Actual timestamp-backed W632 events and frozen recorded velocity. Float32 endpoint expression exactly matches maintained ppt_events.mono_data.
provenance.limitations: Continuous alignment control is provided only for timestamp-backed W632. W221 retained timestamp data is absent from the maintained patch package; older archive has paired coordinates, not timestamps.
